title: Max-Min Throughput in RSMA-Aided SWIPT for Sustainable Internet of Underground Things: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.19865v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-enabled wireless-powered underground sensor networks (WPUSNs) allow underground devices (UDs) to harvest radio-frequency energy from a UAV via wireless energy transfer (WET) techniques, enabling sustainable Internet of underground things (IoUT) applications. This paper integrates rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA)-aided simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) into UAV-enabled WPUSNs to deliver information and energy to UDs. Within this framework, we investigate a max-min fairness problem that jointly optimizes the UAV transmit power, power allocation and message splitting, power-splitting ratios, and time allocation, aiming to maximize the minimum uplink throughput across UDs subject to per-UD downlink throughput requirements and a UAV energy-consumption constraint. translated_title: 面向可持续地下物联网的RSMA辅助SWIPT中的最大-最小吞吐量：一种深度强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 基于无人机的无线供电地下传感器网络（WPUSN）使地下设备（UD）能够通过无线能量传输（WET）技术从无人机采集射频能量，从而支撑可持续的地下物联网应用。本文将速率分割多址接入（RSMA）辅助的同步无线信息与功率传输（SWIPT）集成到无人机赋能的无线供电地下传感器网络中，以向地下设备同时传输信息和能量。在此框架下，我们研究了一个最大-最小公平性问题，联合优化无人机发射功率、功率分配与消息分割、功率分割比以及时间分配，旨在满足各地下设备下行吞吐量要求和无人机能耗约束的条件下，最大化所有地下设备的最小上行吞吐量。为在动态地下环境中求解这一非凸问题，我们提出了一种离策略深度强化学习方法。
tldr: 本文将RSMA辅助的SWIPT引入无人机赋能的无线供电地下传感器网络，并利用深度强化学习联合优化发射功率、功率分配与消息分割、功率分割比及时间分配，在满足各设备下行吞吐量和无人机能耗约束下最大化地下设备的最小上行吞吐量。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates RSMA-aided SWIPT into UAV-enabled wireless-powered underground sensor networks and employs a deep reinforcement learning approach to jointly optimize transmit power, power allocation and message splitting, power-splitting ratios, and time allocation, maximizing the minimum uplink throughput of underground devices under per-device downlink throughput requirements and UAV energy constraints.
